Chen Wei v Public Prosecutor [2024] SGCA 8

CA/CCA 5/2023
2024-01-22
Court of Appeal
Sundaresh Menon CJ
Mr Tan SC for the Appellant; DPP Koh for the Respondent
Chen Wei; Public Prosecutor
Criminal Law — Statutory Offences — Misuse of Drugs Act
Criminal Procedure and Sentencing — Appeal — Conviction

Introduction

1 This is an appeal against the decision of the High Court in Public Prosecutor v Chen Wei [2023] SGHC 55.

2 The appellant was convicted of one charge under section 5(1)(a) of the Misuse of Drugs Act (Cap 185, 2008 Rev Ed).

Grounds of Appeal

3 The appellant raised three grounds: (a) the trial judge erred in admitting the disputed statements; (b) the chain of custody was broken; (c) the sentence was manifestly excessive.

Decision of the Court

4 Having considered the submissions, we find that the trial judge did not err. The appeal is dismissed.

5 We affirm the sentence of 20 years imprisonment and 15 strokes of the cane as imposed by the court below.
